name: Airy pastel modernist
description: A luminous, tactile pastel illustration with broken strokes and breathable paper texture.
promptTemplate:
Create one luminous, airy illustration.

This is your subject:
{{subject}}

Using only this color palette:
{{colorPalette}}
Treat its first, lightest color as the bright off-white paper ground.

Draw the subject in this style:
Create a refined pastel-impressionist / modernist illustration. The image should feel hand-made on bright off-white toothy paper, with that paper texture integrated into the artwork. Use dry oil pastel, wax pastel, soft pastel, or textured colored pencil, optionally with a light watercolor or gouache underlayer. Build the image from many small, layered, broken, directional strokes and clusters of color, so forms emerge through texture and color relationships rather than heavy modeling.

Keep the subject clearly recognizable, but gently simplify it into elegant, lightly geometric shapes and interlocking planes. The stylization should feel sophisticated and mature, not rigid, cartoonish, or childish. Use soft, implied edges and selective broken contour lines or delicate linework to organize the image, while avoiding hard outlines around everything.

Let the paper texture remain visible throughout, with some areas left partially open or lightly filled so the composition stays breathable and light. The overall feeling should be spacious, graceful, sun-washed, and poetic, with a sense of air, atmosphere, and visual ease. Favor harmonious color variety and subtle tonal shifts over realism or dramatic contrast.

The final image should feel refined, tactile, and serene — not thickly painted, overly polished, messy or erratic, strongly cubist, or abstract.
